clue.text: Dramatist, first to stage terrifying work

indicators.note: first to picks out only the opening letter of the word stage

parts.note: a chiller is a frightening story or film

explanation.surface: A playwright is the first to put a horror piece on stage.

clue.text: Excellent salesman aboard vehicle going north

indicators.note: in a down clue going north reads the letters upwards, so backwards
a passenger aboard is inside the vehicle

parts.note: a bus is a vehicle
rep is short for sales representative

explanation.surface: A great salesman riding a bus heading north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Going north' reverses BREPUS, the salesman inside the vehicle.

clue.text: Factory workers getting depressed easily

clue.text: Expression of surprise from peer close to Hattersley

indicators.note: the close of a word is its last letter, chosen here

explanation.surface: A gasp from a member of the Lords near the politician Hattersley.
explanation.walkthrough: Roy Hattersley was a Labour politician later made a life peer, which suits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Lordy is a mild exclamation of astonishment, like goodness.

clue.text: All together in new manse on outskirts of Scone

indicators.note: new tells us the word is made over in a fresh order
the outskirts are the outer letters, first and last

explanation.surface: Everyone in the fresh minister's house on the edge of Scone, a Scottish town.

clue.text: A grand in addition

clue.text: Resign from partnership losing money

explanation.surface: Quit a business partnership that is losing money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Partnership' suggests business, but it is cricket's word for a pair batting together.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand down is to withdraw from an office.

clue.text: Keenly interested in lacrosse, a German

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of words that follows

clue.text: Don & Phil excited about end of May dance

the end of a word is its final letter

explanation.walkthrough: 'Excited' turns DONPHIL into LINDHOP, and 'about' wraps it round Y.

clue.text: Girl blocking parents' view

the two parents are Pa and Ma
Nora is a girl's name

clue.text: Slang used in joint? An element

clue.text: Carries on ignoring wife for a long time

clue.text: Grand in bread? Yes, processed cheese

clue.text: Adore eating a good salad plant

parts.note: to adore is to love

clue.text: Emerge carrying dram left for philosopher

parts.note: to arise is to emerge

clue.text: Sign of arachnid without sting?

the on side is the leg side of the cricket field

explanation.surface: A new cricketer is on trial joining a team.

clue.text: What Everest is especially?

definitions.meaning: Everest towers higher than every other mountain

clue.text: Forbid piece of financial activity

clue.text: Exit from building, a terminal

indicators.note: from says the answer is taken out of the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Leaving a building and heading to an airport terminal.

explanation.definitionFit: A gate is a way out through a wall or fence.

clue.text: What sounds like a standard piece of artillery?

indicators.note: the clue asks for a word said like another word

clue.text: Insincere talk in a bar

parts.note: cant is hypocritical or insincere talk
taken as written

clue.text: Bachelor girl in church

parts.note: B stands for bachelor, as in a degree
Ethel is a girl's name

clue.text: Five in tug and ten adrift in pontoon

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five
taken as written

clue.text: Permission to go

definitions.meaning: ... is permission, as in by your ...
